name: Media
description: Standalone image or video component, optionally with a heading and text. Use for product screenshots, demo videos, or large feature images that stand alone. Don't use when the image is part of a hero with prominent CTAs (use marquee).
visualSignals: Dominant image or video (often full-width or large), minimal text, no CTA prominence.

cols.contains: h2 optional caption heading + p optional supporting text

domInput.notes: If there is no text, use a single-column table (one <td> in the content row, no Col 1). Col 0 = image/video, Col 1 = optional text.
